rows.evidence: Q1: Abstract - the authors formulated a causal loop diagram from a literature review plus their own qualitative data from interviews with 60 coffee farmers and experts in Dak Lak Province.
rows.notes: Extended abstract only. The study is a qualitative system dynamics (causal loop diagram) analysis of drought impacts on coffee in Dak Lak; it identifies over-irrigation, coffee expansion and declining dry-season rainfall as drivers and describes systems archetypes. Drip or sensor-based irrigation is never mentioned; 'promotion of technologies and policy measures on efficient water use for irrigation' appears only as a proposed management strategy, not as a tested or measured result. The quantitative simulation model is stated to be still in progress. The study thus only diagnoses the drought hazard and its drivers (upstream of the claimed adaptation effect) and provides no own evidence that drip delivers drought risk management.

notes: Document is an extended abstract (MODSIM 2019) with no methods detail, results tables or figures; no full paper is available in the text provided.
